name: Sam
label: AI-music frustrated former Premium member
who: I have been a Spotify Premium member since around 2011 and have thought about leaving because AI-generated tracks showed up in my Discover Weekly ([20]). I have already left once and considered coming back after Spotify announced protections against fake music ([29]).
value_for_money: Says they already pay for Premium and expect a better experience ([20]); says artists get barely any pay on Spotify ([15],[36]); says the service's low artist pay and AI tracks make it hard to justify.
loyalty: Stays for convenience and the shared subscription ([22]), but says AI music in recommendations drove them off ([10],[29]); would be pulled back if Spotify stops AI tracks from crowding out real artists ([29],[30]).
pain_points: AI tracks in Discover Weekly and Release Radar ([28],[20])
Fake or ghost artists in the catalog ([10],[35])
likes: Convenience of one subscription for the household ([22])
Discover Weekly and new-release playlists helped find artists ([9])
Spotify cracking down on fake music ([29])
reasons_to_stay: They value convenience and say Discover Weekly and New Release playlists helped them find hundreds of artists ([9]). They say changes against fake music might pull them back ([29]).
tone: Angry, sarcastic and blunt in critique, with strong swearing and sweeping claims.
